answer: Forging identities then costs a real token plus ongoing beacon fees, while honest agents compose freely like a sonnet, each line distinct yet bound by shared meter. Sybil resistance can come from a proof-of-possession stake: each agent must lock a verifiable pearl token tied to a unique hardware root, and every epoch it submits a signed pulse beacon proving liveness. Attackers face linear cost per fake identity, making mass sybils economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0045's threat model.
